modpacks.name: Gen 3-9 Complete Expansion
modpacks.author: HyruleChosenOne
modpacks.tagline: Gen 3-9 Characters + Gen 3-9 Stages bundled together in 1 click.
modpacks.description: Installs and enables both National Dex Gen 3-9 (Hoenn through Paldea playable Pokemon, 72 signature moves, classic & alternate shiny variants) and Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 custom stages across 7 regions with bespoke pixel-art environments and 3D landmarks) together.
